capabilities: Upload images and media files to Bunny.net storage zones
Convert wiki-style embeds into Markdown image links with CDN URLs
Build dynamic upload paths from date placeholders like {{YYYY}}/{{MM}}
Delete local media files after a successful upload
Generate alt text via OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Perplexity
disambiguation: Not a note-publishing tool; it only uploads media files and replaces embeds with CDN URLs.
extras: Setup requires building from source (npm install and npm run build); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores images and media as local vault files, so serving them from a CDN requires manual uploading and link rewriting.
